authority_basis.summary: Operator-directed WP25b publication; checker+results committed; ledger 1960 claimed (seqclaim-0eabda2368bd8a7c37c6d3ab)

operations.title: WP25b: the five L levels are per-class properties, not universal attractors — raw-phase (361-point periodic) trench landscapes of 11 representative textures show each texture trenching only at its own cluster level(s) with chi2 rising to 1e2-1e4 at the other centers; cluster-1 diagonal textures trench at TWO levels (L1 and the cluster-3 level L3, |L|=3.39-3.42e-5); sheet taxonomy: CP-sign pairs (267_302, cluster-3 pair), two-level sheets (cluster 1), singles with non-viable CP mirrors (chi2 1e3-1e4, verified on grid), and the branch-merged 90-deg bottom (cluster 4, L=|J| to 1e-9); the oddball 311_273_u01 trenches at the cluster-0 level (|L|=7.84e-5, chi2=3.52), a near-L0 texture not a sixth level; method correction: the sweep must run in raw phi in [-180,180] because the fit target contains signed unitarity-triangle angles (folded-domain v2 misdiagnosed cluster 1 and the oddball); v2 twin-identity of 267_271/267_279 diagnosed as a common fit-failure artifact (v3 curves differ at 360/361 points while minima coincide); gates 15/16 (one localized 270_369_d00 seed instability disclosed) (ledger 1960)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP25b — the L levels are a classification of viable classes, not a shared valley geometry
operations.body: WP25b (ledger 1960) answers the universality question for your zero-trench direction. Raw-phase trench landscapes (361-point periodic grid, 0.2 deg refinement, gates validated against WP20 stored minima) for 11 representative textures: every texture trenches ONLY at its own cluster level(s); chi2 at the other centers is 1e2-1e4. The five L levels are not universal attractors — they are an ensemble property of which chart classes are viable. Sheet taxonomy: CP-sign pairs at one L (267_302, cluster-3 pair), two-level sheets (cluster-1 diagonal textures realize BOTH L1 and the cluster-3 level L3), singles with genuinely non-viable CP mirrors (mirror chi2 1e3-1e4 computed on grid), and the branch-merged 90-deg bottom of cluster 4 (sin phi = 0.99999, L=|J| to 1e-9). The oddball trenches at the cluster-0 level. Method note with standalone value: the landscape must be swept in RAW phi (signed unitarity-triangle angles in the target break the fold symmetry; cluster-1 trenches live at raw -42.83 and +110.28 deg). The open object is now exactly the magnitude-valley mechanism selecting viable (class, level) pairs. Certificate: results/wp25b_trench_landscape.json.
